description: Carte de vigilance multirisque-avertissements et alertes d'Environnement et Changement climatique Canada is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Sécurité intérieure. La carte de Vigilance multirisque est un produit développé par le ministère de la Sécurité publique (MSP) qui regroupe des avertissements et des signalements sur des phénomènes, d’origine naturelle pouvant avoir des conséquences sur la sécurité des citoyens, des biens et des services à la population. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de la Sécurité intérieure. Its tags are Alerte, Avertissement, Blizzard, Brouillard, Grèle. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, WFS. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
